repairs.before: His father Feng served as Director of the Palace Library under Emperor Yizong and was widely celebrated for his gifts as a writer.
repairs.after: His father Feng served as Director of the Palace Library during the Xiantong era and was widely celebrated for his gifts as a writer.
repairs.reason: Primary Chinese 父逢，咸通中為秘書監，以才名著於時 names only 父逢 and the reign phrase 咸通中; it does not name 懿宗 or 皇帝. English must not supply Emperor Yizong where the source gives era context only.
